_README: Usage notes for published assets, keyed by repository path. The build scans assets/ for the inventory and merges these notes in. A file with no note still publishes, it just carries no guidance. The build never overwrites this file. Add a note whenever an asset has a rule attached to it, and always when an asset is a counter-example.

assets/logos/the-word-for-all-the-world..name: Wordmark, reversed
assets/logos/the-word-for-all-the-world..note: The default reversed wordmark used in the portal navigation and footer.

assets/logos/wordmark-midnight-ink.png.name: Wordmark, Midnight ink
assets/logos/wordmark-midnight-ink.png.note: The letterhead mark. Use on printed and printable documents.

assets/logos/wordmark-on-midnight.png.name: Wordmark on Midnight
assets/logos/wordmark-on-midnight.png.note: Reference lockup showing the flagship pairing.

assets/logos/wordmark-on-word-blue.png.name: Wordmark on Word Blue
assets/logos/wordmark-on-word-blue.png.note: Secondary structural ground. Use where Word Blue carries logo continuity.

assets/logos/wordmark-over-photo-scrim.p.name: Wordmark over photography
assets/logos/wordmark-over-photo-scrim.p.note: The only approved treatment of the mark over imagery. The scrim is not optional.

assets/logos/wordmark-on-flame-not-allow.name: Wordmark on Flame
assets/logos/wordmark-on-flame-not-allow.note: Not permitted. Published only to show the violation. The mark cannot compete with calls to action, and Flame never carries the logo.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.svg.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.svg.note: The default signature. Cleanest of the three full forms and the most legible, so it is the one to use on documents and letterhead unless there is a reason to reach for another. Vector master: scale it, never redraw it.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.png.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, raster
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.png.note: Transparent PNG of the default signature, 1200px tall. For the places that cannot take SVG: Google Docs, PDF and e-sign fields, email signatures. Prefer the SVG everywhere else.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, display
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.note: Faster and more slanted, with a long lead-in and a trailing flick. Holds its energy at large sizes. Not for small settings, where the flick reads as noise.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, display, raster
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.note: Transparent PNG of the display signature, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, compact
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.note: Tightest of the three, with heavier looping on the Z. The one that survives being scaled down.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, compact, raster
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.note: Transparent PNG of the compact signature, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.svg.name: Signature, Nathan Zimmer, short form
assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.svg.note: The short form. Widest stroke relative to its width, so it stays readable in tight spaces like an email footer. Use the full name on anything entered into the record.

assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.png.name: Signature, Nathan Zimmer, short form, raster
assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.png.note: Transparent PNG of the short form, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/images/hero-congregation.jpg.note: Documentary hero still. Text over it requires the Midnight scrim.

assets/images/conference-tent-teaching.j.note: The §07 exemplar for photography as a record. Caption location pending verification against the ministry record.

assets/images/bibles-distribution.jpg.note: Brand-object photography: black covers and red page edges are Flame on Midnight, unplanned. Caption location pending verification.

assets/images/crowd-evening-poster.jpg.note: Still fallback for crowd-evening.mp4. Every loop ships with its poster.

assets/videos/crowd-evening.mp4.note: Muted looping hero footage. Used on the Brand Guide cover.

gaps: A reversed signature for dark grounds. Every signature published here is Midnight ink and works only on Parchment or white. Nothing signed may appear on Midnight, Word Blue, or footage until a reversed master exists. Recolor the SVG fill rather than inverting the raster.

Wordmark masters in SVG and 2x/3x PNG (White, Midnight, Word Blue) are recorded as approved in Brand Guide §06 but are not yet published in this repository. Until they are, request them rather than recreating the mark.
